method.unit: One complete 8 MiB + 37 byte Deflated asset; 128 chunks of 65536 bytes and a 37 byte tail, followed by EOF. FNV-1a and an independent byte-by-byte oracle.
method.timing: Each cold launch uses an identically signed, non-debuggable consumer (no shrinking) and a production, uninstrumented player AAR. Installed package flags verified per launch. After the opening read and first frames, three untimed warm reads then nine unpaced timed reads in the same foreground process. JS performance.now() brackets iteration through EOF. Each pass holds the returned views through EOF and fully verifies bytes outside its timed interval. No memory sampling while timing. Process medians are the units for the four adjacent launch pairs; percentage change refers to per-pair throughput ratios.
method.memory: Independent cold launches, five idle sweeps after a validated opening, 96 back-to-back full reads with rolling verification and no artificial wait, five post sweeps. Only samples with both ends inside the JS wall-clock stream window count. Each sweep measures dumpsys meminfo --local for the app and each renderer bound via Android service records. A process maximum is an observed sample. The attributed sum is a sequential-sweep estimate and does not establish a simultaneous aggregate peak or its lower bound. Process RSS may overlap across processes. PSS/RSS include the entire process state.
method.diagnostics: Private instrumented AAR and project adapter only, 9 full warmed reads per host. Stage sums in microseconds per complete stream. JS callback wait includes native work. readyToTake and jsTake can overlap. JS and Java clocks are never directly subtracted.
method.lifecycle: Identical host/scene loads the same fixture, holds a real stream after 73728 bytes; abort, retry, close during active startup read, reopen, and closed-generation checks. Game-surface PixelCopy compared pixel-for-pixel with analytical atlas oracle.

interruptedThroughputStarts.phase: read-only device-state query before Android launch
interruptedThroughputStarts.recovery: Retried the same side as a fresh process; no other test ran between successful sides.

incompleteMemoryWindows.reason: Device query failed before a complete process-memory sampling record was available. Repeated as a fresh launch.

algorithm.format: RFC 4648 section 4, standard alphabet, padding and no line wraps
algorithm.scope: Only successful nonempty chunk reads use the arm64 encoder. Existing readBytes and readText, cancellation and the script transport are unchanged.

vectors.checks: Compare against the standard encoder with exact-size inputs and inputs with sentinel bytes beyond the requested prefix. Includes the 48-byte vector boundary and the 64 KiB chunk boundary.

selection.scope: Exploratory observations before the final matched application measurements. These trials are excluded from the performance comparison above.

standaloneJavaMs.platform: Isolated ART process on the same Fold7; median of 12 complete encodes of the fixture

stringConstructionMs.platform: Isolated ART process on the same Fold7; median of 12 complete encodes per method; an additional four separately timed scans isolate phase costs

selection.earlyCandidate: Debuggable consumers logged late CheckJNI enablement. Returning a JNI modified-UTF-8 string did not reliably reduce end-to-end time. On WebView its median encode duration was 70.607 ms against 69.595 ms in the same-script baseline. Its debug timings are not combined with the final non-debuggable comparison.
